project.title: Descriptor-bound workspace layout
project.goal: Bind current manifest and selected physical files under owned workspace lease
project.scope: R03/R12 physical layout observation; no SQLite handles or writer authority

boundary.responsibility: Own lease, manifest generation and descendant physical identities
boundary.rationale: Company selection must come from actual bound manifest and paths
excludes: SQLite connection/VFS admission, logical identity adoption and product writes

scenario.normal.description: Canonical existing selected layout binds without source modification

scenario.given: Synthetic existing workspace tree and current manifest
scenario.when: Bind or revalidate held layout under a cooperative lease
scenario.then: Canonical existing selected layout binds without source modification

scenario.refusal.description: Malformed/ambiguous manifests, archive, links/nonregular files and missing unsafe paths refuse

scenario.given: Synthetic existing workspace tree and current manifest
scenario.when: Bind or revalidate held layout under a cooperative lease
scenario.then: Malformed/ambiguous manifests, archive, links/nonregular files and missing unsafe paths refuse

scenario.preservation.description: Root lease and all private descriptors remain held until Drop; ordinary database byte changes permitted

scenario.given: Synthetic existing workspace tree and current manifest
scenario.when: Bind or revalidate held layout under a cooperative lease
scenario.then: Root lease and all private descriptors remain held until Drop; ordinary database byte changes permitted

scenario.correction.description: Typed unique manifest entries replace legacy String/Boolean coercions with explicit fail-closed refusals

scenario.given: Synthetic existing workspace tree and current manifest
scenario.when: Bind or revalidate held layout under a cooperative lease
scenario.then: Typed unique manifest entries replace legacy String/Boolean coercions with explicit fail-closed refusals

scenario.concurrent.description: Physical or manifest change permanently invalidates binding; process ownership excludes contender and releases on death

scenario.given: Synthetic existing workspace tree and current manifest
scenario.when: Bind or revalidate held layout under a cooperative lease
scenario.then: Physical or manifest change permanently invalidates binding; process ownership excludes contender and releases on death

action.workspace_layout.description: Bind and revalidate descriptor-relative selected physical layout

errors.refused: Fixed invalid_manifest, invalid_company_selection, layout_unavailable, layout_changed or existing lease error codes; no partial binding/write effects

preconditions: Existing explicitly acquired WorkspaceLease and synthetic or previously authorized source; no writer authority implied
postconditions: Retained private descriptors and exact manifest generation identify a selected nonarchived registered physical layout; source unchanged

authorization.rationale: Descriptor binding is namespace observation, not SQLite handle proof or atomic hostile-namespace fencing

action.workspace_layout.behavior: Typed bounded manifest and retained no-follow physical descriptors; sticky invalidation
